items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: at a concert by Al Benson

ctx.x: 63rd and Ingleside. So he was living over there. And then, the day that he dropped dead was on a Easter Sunday, I think it was either '51 or '52, at a concert by Al Benson. And I told you the story about keeping the Easter egg from him. So -- see, this is the thing that's so wonderful, is all of these beautiful stories, and they crop up every now and then in your mind, and you think about this different person and that -- Louis Armstrong, and you can think about --
